status: Fixed rules, no optimization, offline archived prices only
entry: Friday 17:00 America/New_York, exact scheduled bar OPEN
exit: Following Sunday 17:00 America/New_York, exact scheduled bar OPEN
missing_endpoint_policy: Skip; never forward-fill, interpolate, or use a different minute
headline_allocation: 100% current cash; fractional BTC quantity = current balance / entry ask proxy
secondary_allocation: Fixed initial USD10000 notional reference; may exceed current equity after losses, not claimed cash-funded execution
spread_proxy: Entry ask = scheduled bid bar open + that bar's recorded spread points * 0.01; exit at scheduled bid bar open. Bar spread is not a synchronized opening ask quote.
financing_policy: Sensitivity only: current archived long swap * point * BTC quantity, with 0/3/4 charges, booked at exit. Historical fees, swap entitlement and exact rollover ordering are unknown.
other_costs: Commission, slippage, historical financing, liquidity, lot minimums and broker margin are not verified or modeled in the headline spread-only result.
